dogecoin.text: This shadowing of global growth by the Dogecoin supply will also tend to provide sufficient liquidity and erase efforts at hoarding of the supply.

That might be a bit high compared to world growth by then.
However, by 2030, the annual gain in the Dogecoin supply will be 2.9%. This may be close to the average annual gain in the global economy.

Since people will not be hoarding the supply of Dogecoin, it will tend to have more practical usage in the economy.
Moreover, the annual supply increase will tend to mimic the growth of the global economy. For example, the annual gain in 2025 will be 3.5%.
Dogecoin has a steady inflationary supply trait which makes it ideal for usage as a currency
